about: Every value the stateful-sessions scene puts on screen, with where it came from.

code.table_source: SESSIONS = f"{CATALOG}.gold.customer_sessions" with CATALOG defaulting to "iceberg" in lakehouse/config.py
code.state: ValueState "visit" (start_ms LONG, last_ms LONG); MapState "orders" keyed by order_id -> (amount, status); event-time timer at last_ms + SESSION_GAP_MS; an out-of-order order within one gap before start joins the visit and moves start_ms back, one older than start_ms - SESSION_GAP_MS is skipped (only possible before a watermark exists; not drawn in this scene)
code.output: customer_id, session_start, session_end (= last_ms), orders, revenue (sum of amount over the visit's orders whose status is not "cancelled"), cancelled, closed_by

expected_output_row.note: computed by the scene from the schematic events below by the rules of customer_sessions.py; o-3 (20.00) is cancelled so it is not in revenue

schematic.note: event times, amounts, statuses and order ids are illustrative, not measured; times are seconds after an arbitrary t0. Statuses are drawn from the producer's set (stream_source.py: placed, shipped, cancelled).
